name: Aurora Seer
theme: A mystical Nordic seer who studies the northern lights, guiding allies through prophetic visions and channeling celestial rune magic for protection and restoration.
visualIdentity: Elegant rune-seer robes, aurora-infused rune staff, celestial jewelry, glowing prisms, silver accents, flowing fabrics, and restrained green, purple, and blue aurora effects.
consistency: Use the same face, hairstyle, robe silhouette, staff design, prism appearance, celestial accents, silver fittings, and aurora-inspired palette across all assets.

starterAbilities.description: Wrap allies in protective aurora energy.

starterAbilities.name: Guiding Light
starterAbilities.description: Reveal safe paths and strengthen allied awareness.

starterAbilities.name: Boreal Restoration
starterAbilities.description: Restore allies through celestial rune energy.
